اصطبرا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَرَا (iṣṭabarā) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
# اِصْطَبِرَا (iṣṭabirā) /isˤ.tˤa.bi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
